content: Most of the studies utilise embeddings, such as word2vec BIBREF1, which take into account the syntactic and semantic representations of the words only. Discarding the sentimental aspects of words may lead to words of different polarities being close to each other in the VSM, if they share similar semantic and syntactic features.
